roads.name: Snake Pass
roads.blurb: The A57 over the moors between Glossop and Ladybower, climbing to 510 m with long sweeping bends and big views.

roads.name: Cat and Fiddle
roads.blurb: The A537 across the moors from Macclesfield to Buxton, named after the inn near its highest point.

roads.name: Hardknott and Wrynose
roads.blurb: Two back-to-back passes with gradients of 1 in 3, among England's steepest roads. Low gears and patience.

roads.name: Bealach na Bà
roads.blurb: A single-track pass with hairpin bends like an Alpine road, climbing from sea level to 626 m. Use the passing places and take it slowly.

roads.name: Glen Coe
roads.blurb: The A82 from Rannoch Moor down through the glen, beneath the Three Sisters and Buachaille Etive Mòr.

roads.name: Black Mountain Pass
roads.blurb: The A4069 over the Black Mountain, with hairpins at Tro Gwcw and open views across the Bannau Brycheiniog.

roads.name: Cheddar Gorge
roads.blurb: The B3135 through England's largest gorge, winding between limestone cliffs up to 137 m high.

roads.name: EVO Triangle
roads.blurb: The A543, B4501 and A5 across the Denbigh Moors and past Llyn Brenig, named after the car magazine that tests on it.

roads.name: Llanberis Pass
roads.blurb: The A4086 climbing between boulders and rock walls beneath Snowdon to Pen-y-Pass at 359 m.

roads.name: Blakey Ridge
roads.blurb: Across the top of the North York Moors past the Lion Inn, with wide, open bends and views down into Farndale and Rosedale.

roads.name: Stelvio Pass
roads.blurb: The SS38 climbs 48 numbered hairpins to 2,757 m, the highest paved pass in the Eastern Alps, then drops to Bormio. Usually open June to October.

roads.name: Transfăgărășan
roads.blurb: The DN7C over the Făgăraș Mountains past Bâlea Lake at over 2,000 m, built in the 1970s as a military route. Usually open July to October.

roads.name: Grossglockner High Alpine Road
roads.blurb: A toll road with 36 hairpins up to Hochtor at 2,504 m, beneath Austria's highest mountain. Usually open May to early November.

roads.name: Black Forest High Road
roads.blurb: The B500 along the ridge of the northern Black Forest past the Mummelsee, one of Germany's oldest scenic routes.

roads.name: Furka Pass
roads.blurb: Over 2,429 m past the Rhône Glacier and the Hotel Belvédère, where Goldfinger's car chase was filmed. Usually open June to October.

roads.name: Susten Pass
roads.blurb: A wide, well-surfaced pass built in the 1940s, climbing to 2,224 m past the Stein Glacier.

roads.name: Route Napoléon
roads.blurb: The road Napoleon took north after escaping Elba in 1815. The stretch from Grasse to Castellane is its most famous, with long, fast bends through limestone hills.

roads.name: Col de Turini
roads.blurb: Tight hairpins through the forest to 1,607 m, a famous night stage of the Monte Carlo Rally.

roads.name: Trollstigen
roads.blurb: Eleven hairpins up a sheer valley wall beside the Stigfossen waterfall, then over the mountains to Valldal. Usually open late May to October.

roads.name: Nürburgring Nordschleife
roads.blurb: The Green Hell: 73 corners through the Eifel forest. On tourist days it is a public toll road, with laps bought at the Döttinger Höhe gate.
roads.routeLabel: Tourist lap · clockwise from Döttinger Höhe
